name: Aapoph Serpentfolk
source: Homebrew example, worked out from the serpentfolk in Pathfinder Monster Core (pg. 302-304: Aapoph Serpentfolk, Aapoph Granitescale), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Monsters.aspx?ID=3182. Not a Paizo adjustment.
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: For an NPC. Replaces its ancestry trait with serpentfolk (or adds it) and adds mutant; Medium (or Large); adds Aklo, Sakvroth, telepathy 100 feet, darkvision, scent, Speed 25 feet if lower, poison resistance, a fangs Strike with serpentfolk venom, +2 status vs. mental; a tail Strike and Slithering Attack (option). Use Zyss or Aapoph, not both.
optional: Aapophs are prone to mutations, which you can choose or roll on a d% (Monster Core's Aapoph Mutations; they have no rules of their own): 1-45 no mutation, 46-56 dual tail, 57-66 additional fangs, 67-84 hooded neck, 85-91 horns, 92-96 additional, vestigial head, 97-100 spiny scales.

choices.label: Size
choices.note: Some aapophs are mutated into larger forms.

choices.label: Serpentfolk venom DC
choices.note: Aapophs have stronger venom than their zyss kin.

abilities.name: Serpentfolk Venom
abilities.description: Saving Throw DC {dc:standard} Fortitude; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1 1d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round); Stage 2 2d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

abilities.name: Serpentfolk Venom
abilities.description: Saving Throw DC {dc:hard} Fortitude; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1 1d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round); Stage 2 2d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

abilities.name: Slithering Attack
abilities.description: {Name} makes one weapon or fangs Strike and one tail Strike, each targeting a different creature. These attacks both count toward {name}'s multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after {name} makes both attacks.
